target_customer: Delivery and logistics operators needing low cost driverless vehicles
problem: Autonomous delivery vehicles were expensive; Faction built small three wheeled electric vehicles with teleoperation to cut cost.
business_model: Vehicle and autonomy services for fleets

founders.name: Ain McKendrick
prior_employers: Palm Computing (early founder, per YC page)
previous_startups: Starsky Robotics (driverless semi trucks, shut down)
founders.background_notes: Employers from the YC page; Starsky link from a search summary of press.

exit.reason: YC lists Inactive but company news shows activity through July 2024; no shutdown found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Driverless vehicles with teleoperation required autonomy software, hardware integration and safety, hard for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Clean sheet vehicle plus autonomy stack on NVIDIA Drive is capital intensive to copy, but it depended on partner chassis such as Arcimoto.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: A 2025 profile names Nuro, Serve Robotics and Amazon Scout as last mile rivals; Amazon Scout was later discontinued.

market_need_then: Last mile delivery demand grew with e-commerce; the seed announcement positions three wheeled vehicles as cheaper (about $30,000 per vehicle per press).

branding.community_and_virality: Press from Electrek, InsideEVs and an NVIDIA blog about the Arcimoto D1 partnership in 2022.

brand_strength.rationale: Coverage was about the product and partners, not the brand; the name is generic.

outcome_analysis: Faction raised a $4.3M seed in June 2021 after YC Winter 2021, added TDK Ventures in December 2021 and a TDK led Series A in October 2023, launching Houston services in July 2024. YC marks it inactive although sources show activity, so the status may be stale. No failure cause is documented.
notes: faction.us returned 503. Series A label comes from a Foley and Lardner snippet; amount undisclosed by TDK and Freightwaves (a $6M figure appears only in an Axios Pro headline and a profile, unverified). Business Wire release and Axios were blocked. Competitors: no source dated near the batch was found for rivals; a 2025 profile names Nuro and others so the list is empty. YC status Inactive conflicts with exit type none. Failure factors left empty because no shutdown or failure is documented.
